prompt: Nobody in the meeting thinks about lenses, drivers or the vendors who made the projector: it just shows the slides, until someone opens the box and finds dozens of parts and people inside.
tells: it just shows the slides, until someone opens the box
why: A working network folds into one unit.
trap: It's one device folded into a unit, not a claim about cause.

prompt: A once-debated lab finding is now cited without question; the experiments, disputes and machines behind it have disappeared into a single taken-for-granted fact.
tells: disappeared into a single taken-for-granted fact
why: Latour: a fact becomes a black box.
trap: SCOT closure is about artifacts' designs across groups; this is a fact's history vanishing.

prompt: Loan officers type in an applicant's data and get back 'approve' or 'decline'; for them the scoring model is only inputs and outputs.
tells: for them the scoring model is only inputs and outputs
why: A complex network treated as one unit.
trap: No one's behavior is reshaped toward the model's picture here.

prompt: When an AI tool gives a biased answer, investigators find the 'single system' was really dozens of datasets, labelers and vendors that had been treated as one.
why: A failure reopens the black box.
trap: It isn't the membership or embeddedness of infrastructure.

prompt: A teacher asks students to describe a microscope as one tool, then as the people, lenses, standards and labs it took to make it work.
tells: then as the people, lenses, standards and labs it took to make it work
trap: It's not about where the apparatus cuts the object.

prompt: Drivers talk about 'the algorithm' as one thing that decides their pay, though it is many teams, rules and data feeds acting together.
tells: as one thing that decides their pay
why: Many actors folded into one unit.
trap: The drivers' framing is the black box, not a claim that tech determines outcomes.
